title: Supercritical sharpness for the random cluster representation of real-valued spin models
summary: We study the supercritical regime $β>β_c$ of a large family of real-valued spin models on $\mathbb Z^d$, including the Blume-Capel and $P(\varphi)$ models. We consider their random cluster representations and prove that they are well-behaved, in the sense that local uniqueness of macroscopic clusters occurs with high probability, uniformly in the boundary conditions. This implies, among other things, a surface-order exponential bound for the (lower) large deviations of the empirical magnetisation. These results were previously known only in the cases of the Ising and $\varphi^4$ models.
